annotations.title: LLM Inference Cost and Gross Margin Calculator

description: Estimates monthly LLM spend, cost per user and per request, prompt-cache savings, savings from routing a share of requests to a cheaper model, and gross margin against a target, for an AI product on any current Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek or Grok model at list price. Compares 9 common models. Same math and the same dated price file as https://modevc.com/tools/llm-inference-calculator.

cache_hit_pct.description: Share of input tokens served from the prompt cache, in percent. Web default 40.

monthly_active_users.zeroNote: the web calculator clamps this to at least 1

price_per_user_usd.description: Monthly revenue per user in USD. Web default 20.

requests_per_user.description: Requests per user per month. Web default 40.
requests_per_user.zeroNote: the web calculator clamps this to at least 1

route_model.description: Cheaper model for routed requests. Web default claude-haiku-5-5.

route_share_pct.description: Share of requests sent to the cheaper model, in percent. Web default 0.

target_margin_pct.description: Target gross margin after model costs, in percent. Web default 80.

name: calc_llm_inference_cost
